resources.string: There is no vault on this device yet. Once you create one, the entries stay here and the codes are computed offline.

Note: this machine has no platform key store, so the master key will be written to a file that only your operating system account can read. Continuing means you accept that; TPM support is not wired in yet.

Logging in takes the master key from a device that is already unlocked: that device shows a pairing code, this one turns it into a request, and its reply comes back after the other side confirms. The master key travels out of band, through the code, and never through a server.
